Internal validity (IV) adjustment (Best guess)
rows.explainer: Based on GiveWell's unpublished estimate We make this downward adjustment because we are very uncertain about the true baseline mortality rate in this population: we think it is possible that mortality may have been going down over time, and the mortality reduction implied without an adjustment seems implausibly large to us.

rows.label: External validity (EV) adjustment (Best guess)
rows.explainer: Based on GiveWell's unpublished estimate We do not apply an external validity adjustment because the effect size estimated in this column is based on inputs that are specific to the location Ansh works.

rows.label: Adjustment for costs saved to hospital (Best guess)
Total adjustment for additional benefits, including cost savings to hospitals (Best guess)
Proportion of KC's benefits coming from mortality (Best guess)
Units of value per dollar given to GiveDirectly
rows.explainer: GiveWell reports this model's result in multiples of cash transfers. Multiplying by GiveWell's value of a dollar to GiveDirectly converts it into units of value per dollar, so it ranks against the other models. Older sheets used older moral weights; the multiple of cash is the comparable number across years.

rows.label: Staff pay as a share of program cost
rows.explainer: Default for programs where staff deliver the help themselves (treatment, counselling, coaching, outreach): staff pay is about half the cost. Our judgment; we haven't seen this program's breakdown.

rows.label: Pay gap versus comparable jobs elsewhere
rows.explainer: Health workers and field staff at nonprofits often earn somewhat less than in comparable jobs. Our judgment.

rows.label: Salary forgone by staff per dollar of cost (in-kind donation)
Share of the full cost paid in cash
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, staff's forgone pay counts as part of the cost, and staff get their share of the outcome. Off, this is 100%.

rows.label: Units of value per dollar
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, times the share of the full cost paid in cash (staff's forgone pay is the rest).
